name: Shawn Hoctor
headline: Real Estate Development & Hospitality Financial Executive
about:
As an accomplished and results-oriented professional with substantial experience and documented success in financial services and operations management, encompassing process optimization, auditing, financial reporting, training, and business development.
Throughout my career, I have built a track record of excellence in developing, implementing, and executing robust initiatives to deliver best-in-class financial analysis and metrics. 
Highly analytical with strong proficiencies in tracking cash flow, assessing strengths/weaknesses in company's finances, and proposing strategic directions. 
I am a competent leader, adept at promoting, modeling, and strengthening culture of service excellence, with focus on timely responsiveness and accuracy. 
Self-motivated with strong accounting, leadership, and analytical skills.

experiences.location: Los Cabos, Baja California Sur, Mexico
